data.summary: “At least he came prepared 😭” has pulled 13,352,969 views at ~182,527/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a story-time whose strongest lever is thumbnail. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: A high-contrast thumbnail with a clear focal subject likely lifts the initial tap rate against a busy Shorts feed.
The topic taps a timely, high-interest subject, so audience intent is likely already searching for and engaging with it.
Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.
